name: threejs-postprocessing
title_zh: 给 Three.js 场景加电影级后期特效
tagline_zh: Bloom 辉光、景深、色彩校正，一行代码接入 EffectComposer。不用手写 GLSL。
tagline_en: Bloom, DOF, color grading—drop in EffectComposer without writing GLSL. Make clients go wow with one line.
desc_en: Three.js post-processing - EffectComposer, bloom, DOF, screen effects. Use when adding visual effects, color grading, blur, glow, or creating custom screen-space shaders.
why_zh: 它把 EffectComposer 的管线封装成声明式配置，按需组合效果器，避免样板代码。
why_en: Wraps EffectComposer into declarative config, composing passes without boilerplate. Built-in common passes plus clear slots for.
limit_zh: 只适配 Three.js 的 WebGLRenderer，不兼容 WebGPU。需要 r150+ 版本。
limit_en: WebGLRenderer only, no WebGPU. Needs r150+. Conflicts with existing custom render targets or post chains. No auto-tuning—you tweak glow intensity.
